text:
maya_sales: Hey team — BrightPath POC wants a temporary hosted pricing change. They asked for lower per-token rates for a 3-week evaluation (generation + embeddings). POC starts Monday; need decision by EOD today. cc @jon_dealmgr @sarah_finops @zoe_salesops

jon_dealmgr: Quick Qs — what's current list price and min charge for hosted? Also do they want a hard commit or just a short-term promotional rate?

maya_sales: Current hosted list: gen $0.0008/token, embed $0.0002/token, min charge $500/mo. They want gen $0.0005 and embed $0.0001 for 21 days. No long-term commit, but they expect ~30M gen tokens/week and ~5M embed tokens/week during the POC.

sarah_finops: Running rough math — at those volumes and requested rates: 30M * 3 weeks * 0.0005 = $45k (gen), embeds 5M *3 *0.0001 = $1.5k, total ~ $46.5k for POC. If we waive min charge that's fine; but finance needs a cap and an accounting/GL code. Also prefer a signed POC addendum with billing cap.

eli_infra: We can implement a custom billing tier for 21 days and enforce a hard token cap. Need SalesOps to create the promo and confirm the customer account id. No infra changes required.

zoe_salesops: I can generate a coupon/promo plan but need Finance approval for moving below list. Two options: 1) Apply a coupon that brings effective rates to requested levels and cap tokens at 100M total for the POC, or 2) issue a $50k credit and bill overage normally. Which does sales prefer?

maya_sales: Option 1 seems cleaner. Cap at 100M total tokens for 21 days (they said they won't exceed). Can we do per-token billing under a "custom-poc" plan so metrics show up in console?

jon_dealmgr: I'm fine approving conditional on finance sign-off and a POC addendum that states: duration, cap, rates, and that we reserve right to revert to list pricing after POC. Also add clause about data retention/privacy (legal will sign).

dealbot: Deal Desk ticket created: DD-2026-1173 — please attach revenue estimate and signed POC addendum. Current status: awaiting finance review.

sarah_finops: Approve in principle. Need: (a) an estimate line item for ARR/one-time credits; (b) GL code; (c) confirmation of token cap enforcement. If SalesOps can set the promo and we get signed addendum, finance will sign off.

zoe_salesops: I'll prepare the promo code and a sample addendum. Proposed promo JSON (for internal use):
```
plan: custom-poc-brightpath
duration_days: 21
gen_rate_per_token: 0.0005
embed_rate_per_token: 0.0001
total_token_cap: 100000000
min_charge: 100
```

maya_sales: Perfect — I'll send the addendum to BrightPath legal now and ask them to sign by EOD. If they push back on the cap, I'll propose a $50k prepaid credit instead.

eli_infra: Once promo is created send account id + promo code to infra; we'll wire up the enforcement rule.

jon_dealmgr: After finance OKs, I can stamp final approval. Thanks everyone. :thumbsup:

maya_sales: cc @sarah_finops @zoe_salesops — tagging for visibility. Will update thread when signed. :eyes:
